{{Short description|French biologist (born 1940)}}
[[File:170221-Alain-Michel Boudet.jpg|thumb|Alain-Michel Boudet at a conference in Toulouse, in February 2017]]
'''Alain-Michel Boudet''' (born 16 March 1940) is a French biological researcher. He is a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences|French Academy of sciences]] and the [[French Academy of Technologies|French Academy of technologies]].<ref name="profil acatech">{{cite web|title=Profil d'Alain-Michel Boudet|url=http://www.academie-technologies.fr/fr/members/19-alain%20michel-boudet|website=Academie-technologies.fr|access-date=26 January 2017|publication-date=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202045104/http://www.academie-technologies.fr/fr/members/19-alain%20michel-boudet|archive-date=2 February 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Studies ==
Alain-Michel Boudet began his studies at the [[Paul Sabatier University]] in [[Toulouse]]. He continued his studies at several international institutions: the [[University of East Anglia]] (1973), the [[University of California, Davis|University of California]] at Davis (1978), the [[University of Fribourg]] (1982), and  the [[Ghent University|University of Ghent]] (1991).<ref name="profil acatech" />

== Career ==
Boudet is the initiator of the Centre Pierre Potier Itav which is located in the [[Oncopole de Toulouse|Toulouse oncopole]] and whose objective is to encourage interdisciplinary collaborations and to bring private and public research closer together.<ref>{{cite web|title=Alain-Michel Boudet : " Le centre Pierre Potier est une réalisation unique en France ". Interview vidéo|url=http://objectifnews.latribune.fr/node/996|website=Latribune.fr|date=20 November 2009|access-date=27 January 2017|publication-date=}}</ref>

== Other functions ==
* Advisor to the board of directors of the association Science Animation<ref>{{cite web|title=Conseil d'administration|url=http://www.science-animation.org/fr/nous-decouvrir/conseil-dadministration|website=Science-animation.org|access-date=27 January 2017|publication-date=}}</ref>
* President of the Academy of sciences, Inscriptions and Belles-lettres of Toulouse<ref>{{cite web|title=Des prix d'excellence pour 28 jeunes chercheurs|url=https://www.ladepeche.fr/article/2015/12/09/2234595-des-prix-d-excellence-pour-28-jeunes-chercheurs.html|author=Philippe Abetel|website=Ladepeche.f|date=9 December 2015|access-date=27 January 2017|publication-date=}}</ref>

== Scientific works ==
Boudet has had more than 160 articles in peer-reviewed journals, several books published, and five patents, He is the organizer of several international colloquia.<ref name="profil acatech" />

== Bibliography ==
* Voyage Au Coeur De La Matiere Plastique : Les microstructures des polymères, CNRS, 2003, {{ISBN|9782271061607}}<ref>{{cite web|title=Voyage Au Coeur De La Matiere Plastique|url=http://www.chapitre.com/CHAPITRE/fr/BOOK/boudet-alain/voyage-au-coeur-de-la-matiere-plastique,1083088.aspx|website=Chapitre.com|access-date=27 January 2017|publication-date=}}</ref>
